## Services

### General Dentistry
- [Brushing & Flossing](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/brushing-and-flossing): The right technique makes all the difference — we'll show you how to brush and floss effectively for a healthier smile.
- [Dental Cleanings & Exams](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-cleanings-exams): Routine cleanings and comprehensive exams are the foundation of a healthy smile, removing plaque and tartar and catching problems early.
- [Dental Sealants](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-sealants): A thin protective coating painted onto the grooves of back teeth to shield them from decay — quick and painless.
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/emergency-dental-care): Toothaches and dental injuries don't wait — call us right away and we'll work to see you as soon as possible.
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/fluoride-treatment): A quick professional fluoride application that strengthens enamel and helps reverse the earliest signs of decay.
- [Initial Consultation & Examination](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/initial-consultation-examination): Your first visit includes a thorough exam, X-rays, and a personalized plan built around your goals.
- [Night Guards](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/night-guards): A custom night guard protects your teeth from grinding and clenching, easing jaw tension and preventing wear.
- [Oral Cancer Screening](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/oral-cancer-screening): A thorough, painless screening included with your exam — early detection of oral cancer dramatically improves outcomes.
- [Oral Hygiene](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/oral-hygiene): Personalized coaching on brushing, flossing, and home care to keep your smile healthy between visits.
- [Preventive Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/preventive-dentistry): Preventive care keeps small problems from becoming big ones, with cleanings, exams, sealants, and fluoride tailored to your needs.
- [Senior Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/senior-dentistry): Gentle, comprehensive dental care tailored to the unique needs of older adults, from dry mouth to restorations.
- [Sleep Apnea Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/sleep-apnea-treatment): A comfortable custom oral appliance can treat snoring and obstructive sleep apnea — a CPAP alternative for many patients.
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/special-needs-dentistry): Compassionate, accommodating dental care for patients with physical, developmental, or sensory needs.
- [Sports Mouth Guards](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/sports-mouth-guards): Custom-fit athletic mouth guards protect teeth and jaws during sports far better than store-bought options.
- [TMJ Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/tmj-treatment): Jaw pain, clicking, and headaches often trace to the TMJ — we diagnose the cause and provide targeted, lasting relief.
- [Tooth Extractions](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/tooth-extractions): When a tooth is too damaged to save, a gentle extraction relieves pain and protects your other teeth.

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- [Botox](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/botox): Administered by our trained dental team, Botox can smooth facial lines and help relieve TMJ-related muscle tension.
- [Dental Bonding](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-bonding): Tooth-colored composite quickly repairs chips, closes small gaps, and reshapes teeth — often in a single visit.
- [Dental Veneers](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-veneers): Thin, custom porcelain shells that transform the shape, color, and alignment of your teeth for a natural, lasting result.
- [Smile Makeover](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/smile-makeover): A personalized combination of cosmetic treatments designed to give you the complete smile you've always wanted.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/teeth-whitening): Professional whitening safely brightens your smile by several shades — far more effective than store-bought kits.

### Restorative Dentistry
- [All-on-4 Implants](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/all-on-4-implants): Replace a full arch of missing teeth with just four implants — a fixed, full set of teeth, often in a single day.
- [Composite Dental Fillings](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/composite-dental-fillings): Tooth-colored composite fillings bond to your tooth and blend in naturally — mercury-free and strong.
- [Dental Crowns & Bridges](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-crowns-bridges): Custom crowns restore damaged teeth and bridges replace missing ones, rebuilding your bite and smile.
- [Dental Fillings](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-fillings): We repair cavities with durable, natural-looking fillings that restore the tooth and protect it from further decay.
- [Dental Implants](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-implants): The gold standard for replacing missing teeth — implants look, feel, and function like natural teeth and can last a lifetime.
- [Dentures](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dentures): Custom full and partial dentures — including implant-supported options — restore your smile, bite, and confidence.
- [Same-Day Dental Crowns](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/same-day-dental-crowns): Using CEREC technology, we design, mill, and place your custom crown in a single visit — no temporaries.

### Endodontics
- [Cracked Teeth Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/cracked-teeth-treatment): We diagnose and treat cracked teeth early to relieve pain and prevent the crack from worsening.
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy relieves the pain of an infected tooth and saves it from extraction — far more comfortable than its reputation.

### Periodontics
- [Antibiotic Periodontal Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/antibiotic-periodontal-treatment): Targeted antibiotic therapy supports deep cleaning to control the bacteria behind gum disease.
- [Cosmetic Gum Shaping](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/cosmetic-gum-shaping): Gently reshape an uneven or gummy gum line to reveal a more balanced, confident smile.
- [Crown Lengthening](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/crown-lengthening): A precise procedure that reshapes gum and bone to expose more tooth — for restorations or a less 'gummy' smile.
- [Gum Disease Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/gum-disease-treatment): Gum disease is the leading cause of tooth loss — we stop it in its tracks and restore your gum health.
- [Laser Gum Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/laser-gum-treatment): Dental lasers treat gum disease precisely, often with less bleeding, less discomfort, and faster healing.

### Oral Surgery
- [Bone Grafting](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/bone-grafting): When the jaw has lost bone, grafting rebuilds a strong foundation so dental implants can succeed.
- [Frenectomy](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/frenectomy): A quick procedure to release a restrictive lip or tongue tie, improving function for infants, children, and adults.
- [Wisdom Teeth Removal](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/wisdom-teeth-removal): Comfortable, expert removal of problem wisdom teeth, with sedation options for a stress-free experience.

### Orthodontics
- [Braces](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/braces): Time-tested braces effectively correct crowding, gaps, and bite issues for kids, teens, and adults.
- [Clear Aligners](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/clear-aligners): Straighten your teeth with clear, removable aligners — no metal brackets or wires, and virtually invisible.
- [Retainers](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/retainers): Custom retainers keep your newly straightened smile in place after orthodontic treatment.

### Pediatric Dentistry
- [Baby Tooth Crowns](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/baby-tooth-crowns): Durable crowns restore and protect damaged baby teeth, preserving them until they're ready to come out naturally.
- [First Visit for Children](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/first-visit-for-children): We make your child's first dental visit positive and stress-free, building healthy habits and trust early.
- [Habit-Breaking Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/habit-breaking-treatment): Gentle appliances and guidance help children stop thumb-sucking and tongue-thrusting habits that affect development.
- [Pediatric Dental Fillings](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-fillings): Gentle, tooth-colored fillings for children, with a caring approach that keeps little patients comfortable.
- [Pediatric Dental Sealants](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-sealants): Protective sealants shield your child's molars from decay during the cavity-prone years.
- [Pediatric Emergency Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-emergency-dentistry): From knocked-out teeth to sudden pain, we provide prompt, gentle care when your child needs it most.
- [Pediatric Fluoride Treatment](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-fluoride-treatment): Professional fluoride strengthens developing teeth and helps your child stay cavity-free.
- [Pediatric Nitrous Oxide](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-nitrous-oxide): Gentle 'laughing gas' helps children relax during treatment and wears off quickly afterward.
- [Pediatric Sedation](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-sedation): Safe, gentle sedation options help anxious or young children stay calm and comfortable during treatment.
- [Pediatric Tooth Extractions](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pediatric-tooth-extractions): When needed, we remove baby teeth gently and comfortably, with a caring, reassuring approach.
- [Pulpotomy](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/pulpotomy): A 'baby root canal' that treats a decayed or infected baby tooth to relieve pain and save the tooth.

### Sedation Dentistry
- [General Anesthesia](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/general-anesthesia): For the most complex cases or special needs, general anesthesia allows complete, comfortable treatment.
- [IV Sedation](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/iv-sedation): IV sedation provides a deeper, carefully monitored level of relaxation for complex treatment or high anxiety.
- [Nitrous Oxide](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/nitrous-oxide): Gentle 'laughing gas' helps you relax during treatment and wears off within minutes, so you can drive yourself home.
- [Oral Sedation](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/oral-sedation): A prescribed pill helps deeply anxious patients relax through treatment in a calm, drowsy state.

### Holistic Dentistry
- [Amalgam Removal](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/amalgam-removal): Safe, careful removal of old mercury fillings using protective protocols, replaced with tooth-colored material.
- [Mercury-Free Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/mercury-free-dentistry): We use safe, tooth-colored, biocompatible materials — never mercury amalgam — for a healthier smile.
- [Platelet-Rich Fibrin (PRF)](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/platelet-rich-fibrin): PRF uses your own blood to speed healing and improve outcomes after extractions, grafts, and implants.
- [Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/platelet-rich-plasma): PRP harnesses your body's natural healing factors to enhance recovery after surgical procedures.

### Technology
- [CEREC Same-Day Crowns](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/cerec): CEREC technology lets us design, mill, and place a custom ceramic crown in a single visit.
- [Cone Beam (CBCT) Imaging](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/cone-beam-cbct-imaging): A 3D cone-beam scan captures a complete view of your teeth, nerves, and bone for precise implant and surgical planning.
- [Digital Impressions](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/digital-impressions): Quick digital impressions capture your teeth precisely and comfortably — no goopy trays.
- [Digital Scanner](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/digital-scanner): Our digital scanner creates precise 3D models of your teeth in seconds for accurate, comfortable treatment.
- [Digital X-Rays](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/digital-x-rays): Digital X-rays give a detailed view with up to 80% less radiation than traditional film.
- [Intraoral Camera](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/intraoral-camera): A tiny camera lets us show you exactly what we see, so you're always informed about your care.
- [iTero Digital Scanning](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/itero-digital-scanning): Fast, comfortable digital scans replace messy impressions for aligners, crowns, and more.
- [Laser Dentistry](https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/laser-dentistry): Dental lasers treat gum tissue and more with remarkable precision — often with less bleeding and faster healing.
